result.topic_en: Riemann postulates a homogeneous substance filling all of space whose velocity equals the resultant of gravitational forces and coincides with the motion of the light-ether, and derives conditions on the gravitational potential V and the velocity components (irrotationality, divergence equal to $-4\pi\rho$, vanishing at infinity).
